# Vendored assets (offline)

All third-party assets are bundled locally so the page runs with **no network / no CDN**.

| Asset | Version | License | Source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `p5.min.js` | p5.js v1.9.4 | LGPL-2.1 | cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/p5.js/1.9.4 |
| `fonts/space-grotesk-*.woff2` | Space Grotesk | SIL OFL 1.1 | @fontsource/space-grotesk |
| `fonts/inter-*.woff2` | Inter | SIL OFL 1.1 | @fontsource/inter |
| `fonts/jetbrains-mono-*.woff2` | JetBrains Mono | SIL OFL 1.1 | @fontsource/jetbrains-mono |

`fonts/fonts.css` declares the `@font-face` rules. Nothing here phones home.
